connection.notes: Observed: PostgreSQL 16 on Neon; database names neondb (production) and heliumdb (development).

roles.read: Dedicated login with SELECT on the catalog profile's catalog tables only.
roles.write: Dedicated login with INSERT and UPDATE on the profile's write tables only. Phase 3, server-side only.

isolation.row_level_security: Available in Postgres; disabled on every table in the observed storefronts, so isolation relies on role grants.

assets.store: Replit App Storage (Google Cloud Storage client)
assets.upload: Application-mediated: request signed upload URL, PUT file, finalize with visibility, store returned object path. Requires application admin authorization.

schema_changes: Replit deployments apply schema migrations to production (recorded in _system.replit_database_migrations_v1). A mapping version is bound to a schema fingerprint; Gate 4 refuses writes when it changes.
verify_before_use: Whether Replit-managed databases support creating additional least-privilege login roles.
Connection limits and pooling for an external worker.
Whether the application exposes a server-to-server upload authorization suitable for Commerce OS.
